answer: Reaching the wharf of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, slashed on a failed audit, rewards vest against future work. Work waits on the kernel until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the tundra of the next round. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
